attr.title: Postal 2
attr.desc: Postal 2 is a 2003 first-person shooter developed by Running with Scissors. Live a week of errands as the Postal Dude in Paradise, Arizona, completing each task in any order, peacefully or violently. Requires your own game files from Steam plus the freeware multiplayer build.
attr.inst:
1. Download the freeware Postal 2: Share the Pain multiplayer Linux build from ModDB and extract its contents into the gamedatamp folder.
2. In Steam, select the 1409 build (Postal 2, right click, Properties, Game versions and betas, select 1409) and copy those files into the gamedata folder.
3. Run "Postal 2 MP (first run).sh" once so the game generates its config files, then quit with Start+Select.
4. Launch "Postal 2.sh" to play.
